description:
Get all permission overrides for a channel.

Args:
  - channel_id (string): Discord channel ID
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  List of permission overrides with allow/deny for each role/member

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_get_channel_permissions
title: Get Channel Permissions
